correctness.rationale: Identified oriented Gr(2,4) with S^2 x S^2 using self/anti-self dual Plucker coordinates, with unoriented quotient harmless to bilinear observables. The rank-two projector trace f_A becomes U^T diag(m_1,m_2,m_3)V and sum m_i^2=tr(A^2). Conditioning on U gives E|f_A|^p=(p+1)^(-1) E(sum q_i U_i^2)^(p/2); the nondegenerate Dirichlet support makes this strictly Schur-concave for 1<=p<2 and strictly Schur-convex for p>2. Thus simplex vertex and barycentre are unique opposite extrema, yielding pair and outlier spectra, all p>=1 and infinity. E f^2=tr(A^2)/9. Independently computed exact rational even moments m=1..4 for four trace-zero spectra, including the quartic identity 4/75[(tr A^2)^2-tr A^4]. This is finite corroboration, not a substitute for strict Jensen.
